meta.title: Open Government of Canada — Maple Leaf model
meta.disclaimer: Demo model. Not the legal Government of Canada. Sample data. Under Maple Leaf rules this is how the real state would look.

nodes.name: Government of Canada (Maple model)
nodes.mandate: Logic-based state for Canadian citizens first. Every material decision under Universal Decision Logic. Books open.

nodes.name: Constitution & purpose
nodes.mandate: Supreme priority: safer, smarter, stronger, richer lives for Canadian citizens and their children.

nodes.name: Legislative
nodes.mandate: Parliament makes law in public. Bills require Decision Packages. The Public Chamber lets citizens chat, call in, and be summarized by AI during debate. For the people, by the people.

nodes.name: House of Commons
nodes.mandate: Elected chamber. Material bills cannot skip Universal Decision Logic. Floor debate streams into the Public Chamber.

nodes.name: Senate
nodes.mandate: Review chamber. Same Decision Package sunlight. Public Chamber remains open during review.

nodes.name: Public Chamber
nodes.mandate: Live citizen chat, call-in queue, and AI view-summary during public debate on any material act. For the people, by the people. Demo at #/chamber.

nodes.name: Executive
nodes.mandate: PMO and ministries operate programs, spend under Trace, and sign Decision Packages.

nodes.name: Prime Minister’s Office
nodes.mandate: Coordinate government; enforce citizens-first and UDL on cabinet.

nodes.name: Finance
nodes.mandate: Tax, fiscal rules, Public Treasury design, family tax power, corporate Canada-first rules.

nodes.name: Health
nodes.mandate: Citizen health covenant, substances by harm, food-linked load on the system.

nodes.name: Immigration & Borders
nodes.mandate: Secure borders; capacity-capped skilled entry; remove violent non-citizens; citizens first.

nodes.name: Defence & National Service
nodes.mandate: Defence capacity and National Service Year (replaces grade 10).

nodes.name: Justice
nodes.mandate: Criminal law, free speech (violence-only line), home defence tools.

nodes.name: Agriculture & Food
nodes.mandate: Food disclosure, UPF ad rules, healthy food tax design with Finance.

nodes.name: Digital & Open State
nodes.mandate: Ledger, Trace, AI State, Extreme Compute Grid, Citizen Issues and waste bounties.

nodes.name: Judicial
nodes.mandate: Independent courts. Charter tests on major Maple acts. Not a policy fashion house.

nodes.name: Public Treasury & Open State
nodes.mandate: Every non-exempt dollar on the ledger. Trace IDs. Citizen issues and bounties.

nodes.name: Federalism
nodes.mandate: Federal–provincial interface. Provinces deliver schools and much of health; federal sets tax, borders, Criminal Code, transfers.

nodes.name: Sovereign wealth
nodes.mandate: Surplus path: invest for citizens, not fashion spend.
